decisions.reason: This award-winning geothermal probe builds squarely on our existing materials, tube and system knowledge, so the positive market signal is one we can readily absorb and scale.

The single-U geothermal probe is closely related to our established product and process base, and as a large firm with relevant innovation capabilities we would be more inclined to refine it than withdraw it quickly.

The surface technology for geothermal probes fits our technical capabilities, but as a more specialized enabling innovation with limited visible traction it faces a somewhat higher rationalization risk than the core system products.

The fire-protection steel profile system is very close to our established building-systems business, which means we can interpret customer feedback well and improve it with existing know-how rather than drop it.

The slim steel profile system is an adjacent extension of our steel profile offering, and in a growing market we would usually keep such a closely related innovation unless clear negative evidence emerged.

The decorative steel profile surface system still leverages our core profile and finishing competences, though its more design-driven niche makes it somewhat easier to discontinue if uptake stays modest.
